blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid misalignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose conebeam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain selfsupervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.
blocks.zh: 随着深入学习的迅速发展,受监督的神经网络方法大大提高了低剂量计算成像术去诺能的性能. 然而,它们需要配对的噪音清洁培训数据,这在实践中很难获得。 一些经典的自监督去诺方法依赖于对像素型独立噪声的假设,使得它们在低剂量CT(LDCT)图像中的相關噪声无效. 考虑到相邻的CT切片之间的高度相似性和较弱的噪声关联性,最近提出的几种自我监督的方法将相邻的LDCT切片用于培训. 尽管如此,这些方法未能有效地说明解剖变异导致的切片间非刚性错配的原因,妨碍了它们满足经典噪声2噪声框架所要求的等同性条件. 在本文中,我们提出"噪声2Match"(Noise2Match),这是一种基于适应性切片间匹配的自控LDCT去诺克方法. 噪声2Match引入了切片间匹配网络,以在相邻切片间建模标签过渡过程,再将校正应用到denoiser的输出上来更好地满足等分条件. 我们理论上证明,在理想化的条件下,使用相邻的LDCT切片来训练噪声2Match,相当于用配对的噪音-清洁图像来监督训练. 我们进一步发现,噪声2Match也可以有效进行低剂量锥体CT(CBCT)去诺活化,这可以归结于它的校正操作会降低切片间噪声的相关性. 据我们所知,Noise2Match是低剂量CBCT的第一个有效的图像域自控方法. 广泛的实验表明,Noise2Match超越了现有的图像领域自我监督的方法,提供了更广泛的适用性和更高的实用价值.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Computed tomography (CT) plays a crucial role in clinical diagnosis. However, X-ray ionizing radiation during CT scanning exposes patients to increased health risks. Although reducing the tube current can lower the radiation dose, it introduces low-dose noise that degrades image quality and compromises clinical diagnosis. Therefore, denoising is of great importance in low-dose CT (LDCT) imaging. With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised denoising methods based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have greatly improved image denoising performance and have been widely applied to LDCT denoising [ 1 ] . For example, Chen et al. proposed a residual encoder–decoder convolutional neural network (RED-CNN) [ 2 ] to learn the mapping from LDCT images to normal-dose CT (NDCT) images. Yang et al. combined Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN) with perceptual loss to develop WGAN-VGG [ 3 ] , which generates more realistic denoised images. These supervised denoising methods require aligned noisy-clean image pairs for training. However, in practical applications, acquiring such paired datasets is expensive, time-consuming, and sometimes infeasible [ 4 ] . Therefore, the practicality of CNN-based supervised LDCT denoising methods remains limited.
blocks.zh: 计算成像法(CT)在临床诊断中起关键作用. 然而,CT扫描过程中的X射线电离辐射使患者面临更大的健康风险. 虽然降低管流可以降低辐射剂量,但它引入了低剂量噪声来降解图像质量并损害临床诊断. 因此,在低剂量CT(LDCT)成像中,取名非常重要。 随着深入学习的迅速发展,基于入声神经网络(CNNs)的有监督的去名法极大地改善了图像去名化性能,被广泛应用于LDCT去名化[1]. 譬如说. Chen等提出了残余编码器-解码器分解神经网络(RED-CNN)[2],以学习从LDCT图像到正常剂量CT(NDCT)图像的映射. 杨等. 结合了Wasserstein基因对抗网络(WGAN)与知觉损失来开发WGAN-VGG[3],生成更现实的去声图像. 这些受监督的去名方法需要配对的噪音-清洁图像对来进行培训。 然而,在实际应用中,获得这种配对数据集是昂贵的,耗时,有时不可行[4]. 因此,基于有线电视新闻网的受监督的最不发达国家去名方法的实用性仍然有限。

blocks.en: To eliminate the dependence on paired noisy–clean image data, the classic Noise2Noise framework [ 4 ] demonstrated that when the noise has zero mean, training a denoising network with another noisy observation of the same scene as the target yields performance comparable to that of using a clean target. However, in practical applications, it is often infeasible to acquire paired noisy–noisy images through repeated scans. Consequently, a series of self-supervised denoising methods that require only single noisy images for training have been proposed. Among them, blind-spot-based methods, such as Noise2Void [ 5 ] and Blind2Unblind [ 6 ] , employ blind-spot structures that guide the model to predict the true value of a pixel from its neighboring pixels to achieve effective denoising. Data-splitting-based methods, such as Neighbor2Neighbor [ 7 ] and Zero-shot Noise2Mean [ 8 ] , create paired noisy sub-images by splitting a single noisy image, extending the Noise2Noise framework to scenarios with only single noisy images. However, these self-supervised methods typically assume pixel-wise independent noise, which limits their ability to suppress the correlated noise in LDCT images [ 9 ] . To address this limitation, recent studies have focused on developing self-supervised approaches specifically designed for LDCT denoising [ 10 ] . Among them, filtering-guided methods, such as USGF [ 11 ] , AG-REDCNN [ 12 ] , and Filter2Noise [ 13 ] , design filtering mechanisms to extract prior information from LDCT images and guide the model to preserve structural details while suppressing noise. Frequency-separation-based methods, such as RIP-Net [ 14 ] and WIA-LD2ND [ 15 ] , decompose images into low-frequency components containing core structures and high-frequency components containing fine details and noise, and optimize them separately for self-supervised denoising. Noise-decoupling-based methods, such as SDCNN [ 16 ] , decompose LDCT noise into signal-dependent and signal-independent components and handle them individually to improve overall denoising performance.
blocks.zh: 为消除对配对的吵闹-干净图像数据的依赖,经典的噪声2Noise框架[4]显示,当噪声有"零"之意时,训练一个去噪声的网络,再对目标相同的场景进行一次叫声的观测,其性能与使用干净的目标相当. 然而,在实际应用中,通过重复扫描获取成对的噪音-噪音图像往往不可行。 因此,提出了一系列自我监督的去名方法,这些方法只需要单一的噪音图像就可以进行培训。 其中以盲点为主的方法,如Noise2Void [5]和Blind2Unblind [6],采用了盲点结构来引导模型从相邻像素中预测一个像素的真实值来达到有效的去诺化. 以数据分享为基础的方法,如"邻来"2"邻来"[7]"零相接"噪声2Mean [8]"等,通过分拆出单一的噪声图像来创建对齐的噪声子图像,将噪声2Noise框架扩展到只有单一噪声图像的情景. 然而,这些自我监督的方法通常假定像素相独立噪声,这限制了它们抑制LDCT图像中相干噪声的能力[9]. 为了消除这一局限性,最近的研究侧重于制定专门为最不发达国家贸易公司去名化[10]而设计的自我监督的办法。 其中,由USGF [11],AG-REDCNN [12],和Filter2Noise [13]等过滤制导的方法,设计了从LDCT图像中取出事前信息的过滤机制并引导模型在抑制噪音的同时保存结构细节. 基于频率的分离方法,如RIP-Net [14]和WIA-LD2ND [15],将图像分解为包含核心结构的低频组件和包含细微细节和噪声的高频组件,并单独优化,进行自控去诺. SDCNN [16]等噪声解接方法将LDCT噪声分解为信号依赖和信号独立的组件并单独处理,以提高整体解接性能.

blocks.en: In recent years, several researchers have noticed that adjacent slices within the same CT volume exhibit distinctive properties [ 17 , 9 ] . On one hand, anatomical structures are inherently continuous in space, and adjacent CT slices contain many corresponding regions belonging to the same tissues, which share equal underlying true values. On the other hand, due to the limited cross-slice interference during CT reconstruction, the noise is more independent between adjacent slices. This indicates that corresponding regions belonging to the same tissues in adjacent slices approximately satisfy the independent and equal-mean conditions required by Noise2Noise. Therefore, some researchers have been exploring how to leverage adjacent slices for effective self-supervised LDCT denoising. Jeon et al. proposed MM-Net [ 17 ] , which utilizes multiple adjacent LDCT slices to guide a multi-scale attention U-Net to ignore random noise within individual slices and focus on shared structural information across slices. Niu et al. proposed a similarity-based self-supervised method, Noise2Sim [ 9 ] , which computes the pixel-wise similarity between the current slice and one of its adjacent slices, excludes pixels with dissimilarity exceeding a predefined threshold, and optimizes the denoising model using only the remaining similar pixel pairs. Noise2Sim has been demonstrated to effectively remove correlated noise in LDCT images. Wang et al. proposed a similarity-based visual blind-spot scheme (SVB) [ 18 ] . SVB only uses adjacent slices with noise correlation below a set threshold as training data, and introduces blind-spot strategies into Noise2Sim to remove noise more adequately.
blocks.zh: 近年来,一些研究人员注意到,同一CT体积内的相邻切片显示出了独特的特性[17,9]. 一方面,解剖结构在空间中具有内在的连续性,相邻的CT切片包含许多属于同一类组织的相应区域,它们具有等同的内在真值. 另一方面,由于CT重建期间交叉切片干扰有限,相邻切片之间的噪音较为独立. 这表明,在相邻切片中属于同一组织的相应区域大约满足了Noise2Noise所要求的独立和等同条件. 因此,一些研究人员一直在探索如何利用相邻的片段来有效地进行自我监督的最不发达国家取消提名。 Jeon等人提出了MM-Net[17],它利用多个相邻的LDCT切片来引导多尺度的注意U-Net忽略单个切片中的随机噪声,并专注于共享跨切片的结构信息. 牛等编. 提出了一种基于相似性的自控方法"Noise2Sim [9]",该方法计算出当前切片与其相邻切片之一之间的像素相近相近相近相相相近相相近相相相近相相近相相相近相相相近相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 已经证明噪声2Sim可以有效去除LDCT图像中的相干噪声. 王等编. 提出了基于相似性的视觉盲点方案[18]。 SVB只使用相邻的相邻切片,噪声相关度低于设定阈值作为训练数据,并将盲点策略引入到噪声2Sim中来更充分地去除噪声.

blocks.en: Although these adjacent-slice-based self-supervised methods have demonstrated acceptable performance in LDCT denoising, they do not effectively satisfy the equal-mean condition required by Noise2Noise. For example, Noise2Sim assumes that same-coordinate regions of adjacent slices with dissimilarity below a set threshold belong to the same tissues, making it reasonable to compute pixel-wise loss within these regions (as shown in Fig. 1 (a)). However, due to longitudinal anatomical variation, the same tissue may exhibit non-rigid spatial misalignments between adjacent slices (as shown in Fig. 1 (b)). Therefore, even if the dissimilarity between same-coordinate regions is less than the threshold, there remains a high probability that they belong to different tissues. This indicates that directly computing loss between same-coordinate pixels cannot properly satisfy the equal-mean condition, and may lead to suboptimal constraints for the model. Similar issues also exist in other adjacent-slice-based self-supervised methods.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些相邻的基于虱子的自我监督方法在LDCT去Noise中表现出可接受的性能,但它们并没有有效地满足Noise2Noise所要求的等同性条件. 例如,Noise2Sim假设相邻切片在设定阈值以下的同坐标区域属于同一类组织,因此合理计算出这些区域内的像素偏差(见图1(a))。 然而,由于纵向解剖变异,同一组织可能在相邻切片之间出现非硬化空间错配(如图1(b)所示)。 因此,即使同坐标区之间的相差小于阈值,它们仍极有可能属于不同的组织. 这表明,同坐标像素之间的直接计算损失无法适当满足等位条件,并可能导致模型受到次优限制. 其他相邻的切片自控方法也存在类似问题.

blocks.en: In fact, self-supervised training based on adjacent LDCT slices can be formulated as a problem of learning from unreliable (or noisy) labels , which is an important topic in deep learning theory and aims to train robust models in the presence of annotation errors [ 19 , 20 ] . Current approaches in this field mainly include: (1) label-transition-matrix-based methods [ 21 ] , which model the label corruption or transition process and perform correction accordingly; (2) regularization-based methods [ 22 ] , which design specialized network architectures or training schemes to suppress fitting to incorrect labels; (3) loss-reweighting-based methods [ 23 ] , which adjust the contribution of each sample to the loss function based on its estimated importance. Inspired by label-transition-matrix-based methods, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent LDCT slices, and then applies the estimated transition matrix to correct the output of the denoiser, ensuring that pixels belonging to the same tissues are properly matched pairwise across adjacent slices. In this way, our method allows the transfer of the supervision signal between adjacent slices to adapt to non-rigid spatial misalignments caused by longitudinal anatomical variation. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy–clean images. Experimental results demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms both conventional denoising algorithms and state-of-the-art self-supervised deep learning methods in LDCT denoising.
blocks.zh: 事实上,基于相邻的LDCT切片的自我监督培训可以被编为从不可靠(或吵闹)标签中学习的问题,这是深层学习理论中的一个重要课题,目的是在有注释错误的情况下训练强健的模型[19,20]. 这一领域的现行做法主要包括:(1)基于标签的过渡-矩阵方法[21],该方法模拟了标签腐败或过渡过程并进行相应的纠正;(2)基于规范化的方法[22],该方法设计了专门的网络架构或培训计划来抑制与不正确的标签相匹配;(3)基于损失再加权的方法[23],该方法根据其估计重要性调整了每个样本对损失函数的贡献. 在基于标签-过渡-矩阵方法的启发下,我们提出Noise2Match,这是一种基于适应性切片间匹配的自控LDCT去诺克方法. 噪声2Match引入了相邻的LDCT切片之间的相接相接网络来建模标签过渡过程,然后应用估计的过渡矩阵来纠正denoiser的输出,确保属于同一类组织的像素在相邻切片之间正确配对. 这样,我们的方法就可以在相邻切片之间转移监督信号来适应由纵向解剖变化引起的非刚性空间错位. 我们理论上证明,在理想化条件下,使用相邻的LDCT切片来训练噪声2Match相当于用配对的噪音-干净图像来监督训练. 实验结果显示,Noise2Match在LDCT去Noise同时超越了常规去诺能算法和最先进的自我监督的深层学习方法.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose cone-beam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. Considering that the optical crosstalk in flat-panel detector scintillators and 3D cone-beam reconstruction algorithms (e.g., FDK [ 24 ] ) lead to higher inter-slice noise correlation in reconstructed CBCT images [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] , most existing self-supervised CBCT denoising methods rely on projection-domain data [ 28 , 29 ] . Noise2Match provides a practical solution for performing self-supervised denoising directly in the image domain, making it highly promising for clinical applications.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们发现噪声2Match还可以有效进行低剂量锥束CT(CBCT)去诺活化,这可以归结于它的校正操作会降低切片间噪声的相关性. 考虑到平板探测器闪烁器和3D锥梁重建算法(如FDK [24])中的光学对接器导致重建CBCT图像中更高的切片间噪声关联性[25,26,27],大多数已存在的自监控CBCT去诺方法依赖于投影域数据[28,29]. 噪声2 Match为在图像领域直接进行自我监督的去诺化提供了一个实用的解决方案,使其在临床应用上很有希望.

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of this work are as follows. First , we formulate self-supervised training based on adjacent LDCT slices as a problem of learning from unreliable labels and, based on this formulation, propose a novel adjacent-slice-based self-supervised LDCT denoising method, Noise2Match. Second , we theoretically prove that training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training using paired noisy–clean images under idealized conditions. Third , experimental results on multiple datasets show that Noise2Match achieves superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art self-supervised methods. More importantly , to the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective self-supervised method that can accomplish low-dose CBCT denoising solely in the image domain, which remains a challenging task for current image-domain self-supervised methods. Therefore, Noise2Match offers broader applicability and greater practical value. Our code is available at https://github.com/LangruiZhou/Noise2Match.
blocks.zh: 总之,这项工作的主要贡献如下。 首先,我们根据相邻的LDCT切片来制定自我监督的培训,作为从不可靠的标签中学习的问题,并根据这一提法,提出一种新的相邻的Slice自监督的LDCT去Noise2Match方法. 第二,我们从理论上证明,使用相邻的LDCT切片的噪声2Match培训相当于在理想化条件下使用对齐的噪音-清洁图像的有监督的培训。 第三,多个数据集的实验结果显示,与现有的最先进的自控方法相比,"噪声2Match"实现了优异的性能. 更重要的是,就我们所知,"噪声2Match"是第一个能够完全在图像领域实现低剂量CBCT去Noing的有效自控方法,这对于当前图像领域自控方法来说仍然是一个挑战性的任务. 因此,噪声2Match提供了更广泛的适用性和更大的实用价值. 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/LangruiZhou/Noise2Match.

blocks.en: Therefore, the model trained on paired noisy–noisy images in Noise2Noise can achieve denoising performance comparable to that of a supervised model trained on noisy–clean pairs. Adjacent-slice-based self-supervised LDCT denoising is essentially an implementation derived from the Noise2Noise framework [ 17 , 9 ] , where the key idea is to construct approximately paired noisy training samples using adjacent slices. Adjacent LDCT slices exhibit a dual nature: on one hand, they are highly similar due to the spatial continuity of anatomical structures; on the other hand, longitudinal anatomical variation introduces non-rigid misalignments, making it challenging to fully satisfy the equal-mean condition required by Noise2Noise between same-coordinate pixels of adjacent slices. Consequently, the effectiveness of such methods critically depends on whether they can mitigate the interference in model optimization, which arises from mean differences between same-coordinate pixels of adjacent slices.
blocks.zh: 因此,在Noise2 Noise中,在对齐的噪音-噪音图像上训练的模型可以实现比起在噪音-清洁对齐上训练的被监督模型的去诺能性能. 基于相邻的切片自控的LDCT去Noise基本上是由Noise2Noise框架[17,9]衍生出来的执行,其中的关键想法是用相邻切片来构建大约对齐的吵闹训练样本. 相邻的LDCT切片表现出了双重性质:一方面,由于解剖结构的空间连续性,它们高度相似;另一方面,纵向解剖变异引入了非刚性错配,使得完全满足邻接切片同坐标像素之间的Noise2Noise要求的等同物条件具有挑战性. 因此,这些方法的有效性关键地取决于它们是否能够减轻模型优化中的干扰,这种干扰来自相邻切片同坐标像素之间的正差.

blocks.en: III-A Datasets

blocks.en: III-A 1 Mayo 2016 Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A 1 Mayo 2016 数据集

blocks.en: We utilized the “2016 NIH-AAPM-Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT Grand Challenge” dataset [ 31 ] for training and testing, which contains 5,936 pairs of noisy-clean CT images from 10 patients with a slice thickness of 1 mm. Unless otherwise specified, we randomly selected data from 9 patients for training and used the remaining 1 patient for testing. The training set included 5,326 slices, while the test set contained 610 slices. The image size in this dataset is 512 × \times 512.
blocks.zh: 我们利用了“2016年NIH-APM-Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT Grand Challenge”数据集用于培训和测试,其中包含有10名患者的5,936对有声清洁CT图像,片厚为一毫米。 除非另有说明,否则我们从9名病人中随机抽取数据进行培训,并将其余1名病人用于检测。 训练套装有5,326片,而试验套装有610片. 此数据集的图像大小为512 ×\times 512.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Mayo 2020 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2020年5月2日数据集

blocks.en: To further validate the performance of different methods on clinical low-dose CT datasets, we additionally utilized the “Low-Dose CT Image and Projection Dataset” released by the Mayo Clinic in 2020 [ 32 ] . This dataset contains paired noisy-clean CT scans of the head, abdomen, and chest from 299 patients. We selected the abdominal CT data for training and testing. The training set consisted of 7,293 slices from 45 patients, while the test set included 866 slices from 5 patients. The image size in this dataset is 512 × \times 512.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证临床低剂量CT数据集不同方法的性能,我们额外使用了Mayo诊所2020年发布的"Low-Dose CT影像和投影数据集" [32]. 这个数据集包含了299名患者头部,腹部和胸口的对接而成的噪音清洁CT扫描. 我们选取了腹部CT数据来进行培训和测试. 培训包括45名病人的7 293分片,而测试包括5名病人的866分片。 此数据集的图像大小为512 ×\times 512.

blocks.en: III-A 3 Piglet Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A 3 小猪数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate the denoising performance of different methods across various types of datasets, we further used the piglet dataset [ 33 ] acquired with a GE Discovery CT 750 HD scanner, which contains 800 CT slices from a piglet, each with a pixel size of 0.63 × \times 0.63 mm 2 and a thickness of 0.625 mm. For each slice, the dataset provides scans at normal dose, 50% dose, 25% dose, 10% dose, and 5% dose levels. In our experiments, we used the 25% dose images to train self-supervised models, and the normal-dose images were used to assess their denoising performance. The image size in this dataset is 512 × \times 512.
blocks.zh: 为了评价不同类型数据集不同方法的去诺能性能,我们进一步使用了用GE Discovery CT 750 HD扫描仪获得的"小猪"数据集[33],该数据集包含从一头小猪身上取出800个CT切片,每片像素大小为0.63×\时为0.63毫米2,厚度为0.625毫米. 对于每个切片,数据集提供正常剂量,50%剂量,25%剂量,10%剂量,5%剂量水平的扫描. 在我们的实验中,我们用25%的剂量图像来训练自我监督的模型,正常剂量的图像被用来评估它们的去诺能性能. 此数据集的图像大小为512 ×\times 512.

blocks.en: III-A 4 Real-World CBCT Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A 4 现实世界的CBCT 数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of different methods on the low-dose CBCT denoising task, we performed scans on two rats using a Hiscan XM cone-beam micro-CT scanner, with an isotropic resolution of 13 μ \mu m, a tube voltage of 60 kV, a tube current of 134 μ \mu A, and an angular interval of 0.5 degrees. The training set consisted of 1,167 low-dose CBCT images from one rat, while the test set included 1,167 low-dose CBCT images from the other. Corresponding NDCT images were not provided in this dataset. Each image was cropped to a size of 1152 × \times 1152.
blocks.zh: 为了评价不同方法在低剂量CBCT去诺能任务上的性能,我们用Hiscan XM锥束微CT扫描仪对两只大鼠进行了扫描,同分分辨率为13 μ\mu m,管电压为60千伏,管电流为134 μ\mu A,角相距为0.5度. 训练集由一鼠出产的1,167个低剂量CBCT影像组成,而试验集则包括另一鼠出产的1,167个低剂量CBCT影像. 本数据集未提供相应的NDCT图像. 每张相片被收成大小为1152 ×\times 1152.

blocks.en: III-A 5 ICASSP CBCT Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A 5 ICASSP CBCT 数据集

blocks.en: To further validate the performance of various methods on clinical low-dose CBCT datasets, we additionally utilized the dataset from the “2024 ICASSP Low-Dose CBCT Reconstruction Challenge” [ 34 ] . Utilizing the LIDC-IDRI chest CT dataset [ 35 ] as the ground truth, this dataset simulates clinical low-dose CBCT data for 1,010 patients (the number of incident photons is set to 10 5 10^{5} ). We selected 5,120 slices from 20 patients to construct the training set, and selected 768 slices from 3 patients to construct the test set. The image size in this dataset is 256 × \times 256.

blocks.en: III-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 三-B 执行细节

blocks.en: The denoising network f θ f_{\theta} was implemented based on U-Net [ 36 ] with a residual connection. Following [ 23 ] , the inter-slice matching network M ϕ M_{\phi} was implemented as a U-Net variant with both input and output channel numbers set to 2. The model was optimized using the Adam optimizer, with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . The number of training epochs was 80, and the batch size was set to 4. Noise2Match was implemented in PyTorch and trained on one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU (24 GB). The hyperparameters in the loss function were set to λ C ​ o ​ r ​ r = 1 \lambda_{Corr}=1 and λ S ​ m = 0.001 \lambda_{Sm}=0.001 . The threshold t ​ h th used for loss reweighting was set to 80 HU. The parameter k k was set to 1 for the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, Piglet, and ICASSP CBCT datasets, and to 2 for the Real-World CBCT dataset. The strategy for selecting k k is described in detail in Section III-H2 . All images were normalized to the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] before being fed into the network.

blocks.en: We compared the proposed Noise2Match with three different types of denoising methods: (1) traditional method : Three-dimensional Block Matching (BM3D) [ 37 ] ; (2) supervised methods : RED-CNN [ 2 ] and Noise2Clean [ 36 ] ; (3) self-supervised methods : Noise2Void [ 5 ] , Neighbor2Neighbor [ 7 ] , SDCNN [ 16 ] , MM-Net [ 17 ] , Noise2Sim [ 9 ] and SVB [ 18 ] . Among these, Noise2Clean employed the same network architecture as the denoising network of Noise2Match and was trained in a supervised manner using paired noisy–clean data. The remaining comparative methods were implemented following the settings provided in their original papers or official open-source codes. To quantitatively evaluate the denoising performance of the different methods, we employed three commonly used image quality metrics: peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), and root mean squared error (RMSE). All quantitative denoising performance metrics reported for Noise2Match were computed directly from the denoiser output f θ f_{\theta} , without using the inter-slice matching network M ϕ M_{\phi} , correction operation, or any spatial resampling during inference.

blocks.en: In this section, we trained different deep learning models on the training sets of the Mayo 2016 and Mayo 2020 datasets, and evaluated the performance of all methods on their corresponding test sets. Fig. 3 presents representative image results from different methods, along with their residual maps relative to the NDCT images (ground truth). BM3D exhibited poor content fidelity, with many erroneous structures in the resulting images. The supervised methods, RED-CNN and Noise2Clean, effectively suppressed low-dose noise but tended to over-smooth the images, leading to the loss of structural details, as evidenced by the blurred tissue structures marked by red arrows in the regions of interest (ROIs) in Fig. 3 (d) and (e). From the residual maps, it is evident that Noise2Void and Neighbor2Neighbor barely suppressed the low-dose noise, which can be attributed to the correlated low-dose noise violating the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise. SDCNN achieved a certain degree of noise suppression through its noise-decoupling mechanism. However, the noise removal was still insufficient, with residual granular textures still visible in the denoised images, which also appeared slightly smoothed. Among the adjacent-slice-based self-supervised methods, MM-Net effectively mitigated low-dose noise, but some residual noise persisted in its resulting images, and slight CT value shifts could be observed in the background areas of the residual maps. Compared to MM-Net, Noise2Sim and SVB exhibited superior denoising capabilities. However, minor residual noise was still observable in the results of Noise2Sim, and the outputs of SVB were slightly over-smoothed. As indicated by the red arrows in the ROIs in Fig. 3 (j) and (k), both Noise2Sim and SVB had limitations in preserving fine tissue structures. Among all self-supervised methods, only Noise2Match demonstrated clear structural details within the ROIs, which may be attributed to its better adherence to the equal-mean condition. The above experimental results indicate that the proposed Noise2Match not only effectively removes low-dose noise but also excels in preserving textures and maintaining structural details.

blocks.en: Table I presents the quantitative results of all methods on the test sets. Our Noise2Match outperformed all traditional and self-supervised methods. On both the Mayo 2016 and Mayo 2020 datasets, the improvements of Noise2Match over Noise2Sim and SVB were statistically significant for all three metrics (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). blocks.en: III-D Performance Comparison on Single LDCT Volume
blocks.zh: 三-D 单一最不发达国家的业绩比较 数量

blocks.en: In some special scenarios, particularly when rare lesions with distributions substantially different from those of normal tissues are present, denoising models trained on CT data from other patients often exhibit limited generalization to these specific lesions or anatomical structures. Meanwhile, the scarcity of such special samples makes it difficult to obtain sufficient dedicated training data. Therefore, performing denoising directly on a single LDCT volume using self-supervised methods holds important research significance and practical value. In this section, we additionally selected data from a patient with liver lesions in the Mayo 2016 Dataset and further used the Piglet Dataset. Both datasets contain paired LDCT and NDCT images from a single CT volume. We first trained different self-supervised models using the LDCT images from each dataset and then evaluated their denoising performance based on the corresponding NDCT images. Fig. 4 presents representative results of different methods on both datasets. It can be observed that Noise2Void and Neighbor2Neighbor still failed to effectively suppress the correlated noise in LDCT images. SDCNN was able to suppress the noise to some extent, but its overall performance remained inferior to that of the adjacent-slice-based self-supervised baselines, and its ability to preserve key structures, such as low-contrast lesions, was relatively limited. MM-Net generally preserved the overall anatomical structures well, but noticeable residual noise remained in its outputs. Noise2Sim and SVB achieved stronger noise suppression; however, as indicated by the yellow arrows in the ROIs, the lesion boundaries in their denoised results remained relatively indistinct. In contrast, our proposed Noise2Match not only effectively suppressed low-dose noise but also better preserved image content and structural information, while providing improved boundary preservation for the low-contrast liver lesions in the Mayo 2016 Dataset.
blocks.zh: 在一些特殊情况下,特别是在存在分布与正常组织大相径庭的罕见病变时,对其他病人接受过CT数据培训的去诺化模型往往对这些特定病变或解剖结构的概括性有限。 同时,这种特殊样品的缺乏使得难以获得足够的专门培训数据。 因此,使用自我监督的方法直接在单一的最不发达国家贸易量上打假具有重要的研究意义和实际价值。 在本节中,我们还从Mayo 2016 Dataset的肝脏损伤患者中选取了一些数据,并进一步使用了"小猪"数据集. 两个数据集都包含从单个CT卷中成对的LDCT和NDCT图像. 我们首先利用每个数据集的LDCT图像培训了不同的自我监督模型,然后根据相应的NDCT图像评估了它们的去名性能. 图4介绍了两种数据集不同方法的代表性结果。 可以看到,Noise2Void和Neigbor2Neighbor仍然未能有效抑制LDCT图像中的相通噪声. SDCNN在一定程度上抑制了噪声,但其总体性能仍然低于相邻的虱子自控基线,并保持了低相相撞损伤等关键结构的能力相对有限. MM-Net一般保存了整体解剖结构,但其产出中仍然有明显的残留噪音。 噪声2Sim和SVB实现了更强烈的噪声抑制;然而,正如ROI中黄色箭头所显示的,其去声效果的损伤界限仍然相对模糊. 相比之下,我们提议的Noise2Match不仅有效抑制了低剂量噪音,而且保存了较好的图像内容和结构信息,同时为Mayo 2016 Dataset中低血压肝脏损伤提供了更好的边界保护.

blocks.en: III-E Performance Comparison on Low-Dose CBCT Datasets
blocks.zh: 低剂量CBCT性能比较 数据集

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluated the performance of various self-supervised methods on low-dose CBCT denoising. All self-supervised models were trained and tested on the Real-World CBCT and ICASSP CBCT datasets. Fig. 5 shows representative image results from different methods. It can be observed that Noise2Void and Neighbor2Neighbor failed to effectively suppress the noise in the CBCT images. SDCNN achieved only limited denoising performance on the CBCT datasets. On the Real-World CBCT dataset, noticeable residual noise remained in the denoised images, whereas on the ICASSP CBCT dataset, granular artifacts were observed in the denoised results. The SDCNN outputs also exhibited a certain tendency toward over-smoothing. The adjacent-slice-based baseline methods, including MM-Net, Noise2Sim, and SVB, also showed markedly degraded denoising performance on the CBCT datasets. This is likely because the noise in adjacent CBCT slices exhibits relatively strong correlation, which violates the assumption of inter-slice noise independence. Notably, although Theorem 1 also assumes independent noise between adjacent slices, Noise2Match was still able to effectively remove low-dose noise while preserving anatomical structures. This could be attributed to the correction operation during Noise2Match training, which can match pixels that were originally located at different spatial positions in adjacent slices and exhibited weaker noise correlation, thereby reducing the noise correlation between the corrected adjacent slices. In the subsequent Section III-F , we further analyze the inter-slice noise correlation and verify the above deduction.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价了各种自我监督的方法在低剂量CBCT去Noing上的性能. 所有自我监督的模型都接受了Real-World CBCT和ICASSP CBCT数据集的培训并进行了测试. 图5显示了不同方法产生的代表性图像结果. 可以看出,Noise2Void和Neigrobor2Neigrobor未能有效压制CBCT图像中的噪音. SDCNN在CBCT数据集上只实现了有限的去名性能. 在真实世界的CBCT数据集上,在被点名的图像中仍然有明显的残留噪音,而在ICASSP CBCT数据集上,在被点名的结果中观察到了颗粒状文物。 SDCNN的产出也呈现出某种过于平稳的趋势。 相邻的基于剪切的基线方法,包括MM-Net、Noise2Sim和SVB,也显示CBCT数据集的去诺能明显下降。 这可能是因为相邻的CBCT切片中的噪声表现出相对强烈的关联性,这违反了切片间噪声独立的假设. 值得注意的是,虽然定理1也假设相邻切片之间有独立的噪声,但噪声2Match仍然能够在保留解剖结构的同时有效去除低剂量噪声. 这可以归因于Noise2Match训练期间的校正操作,它可以匹配原本位于相邻切片中不同空间位置并表现出较弱噪声关联的像素,从而降低被校正相邻切片之间的噪声关联. 在接下来的第三-F节中,我们进一步分析了相片间噪声的关联性,并验证了上述推论.

blocks.en: Quantitative results are listed in Table III . Considering the lack of clean reference images in the Real-World CBCT dataset, we additionally introduced the Contrast-to-Noise Ratio (CNR) [ 38 ] and Standard Deviation (Std) as supplementary quantitative measures of tissue contrast and noise suppression. Specifically, as shown in Fig. 6 , for the representative slices from the Real-World CBCT and ICASSP CBCT datasets presented in Fig. 5 , we further manually selected yellow and blue ROIs from two homogeneous regions. For each dataset, ROIs with identical sizes and spatial locations were applied to the LDCT image and the outputs of all competing methods. The ROIs were selected within homogeneous regions and away from visible tissue boundaries to reduce the influence of anatomical variations on the CNR and Std calculations. The yellow and blue ROIs were used to calculate CNR, while the yellow ROI was additionally used to calculate Std. Since CNR and Std are sensitive to ROI selection, the reported values were calculated only from the representative slices shown in Fig. 6 and are intended as supplementary quantitative measures to the qualitative comparison rather than as dataset-level performance metrics. Noise2Void and Neighbor2Neighbor achieved quantitative results only slightly better than those of the original LDCT images, whereas the adjacent-slice-based self-supervised baselines, including MM-Net, Noise2Sim, and SVB, generally achieved better performance. Although SDCNN obtained favorable CNR and Std values, its overall quantitative performance on the ICASSP CBCT dataset remained inferior to the stronger adjacent-slice-based baselines, particularly Noise2Sim and SVB, which may be related to its tendency toward over-smoothing. To further investigate this issue, we performed a line-profile analysis across an airway boundary along the green line segment indicated in Fig. 6 (a1), as shown in Fig. 7 . As indicated by the red arrows, the green curve corresponding to SDCNN exhibits a more gradual intensity transition across the airway boundary, providing further evidence of over-smoothing. In contrast, the red curve corresponding to Noise2Match maintains a relatively steep intensity transition, with a transition trend similar to that of the original LDCT image. This indicates that Noise2Match can effectively suppress noise while preserving the airway boundary without obvious over-smoothing. Overall, Noise2Match achieved the best quantitative performance on both CBCT datasets and showed clear advantages over the competing self-supervised methods. These quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that Noise2Match can effectively perform low-dose CBCT denoising in a self-supervised manner while maintaining favorable tissue contrast, noise suppression, and structural preservation.
blocks.zh: 量化结果见表三。 考虑到真实世界CBCT数据集中缺乏干净的参考图像,我们还引入了对比比(CNR)[38]和标准偏差(Std)作为组织对比和噪声抑制的补充定量计量. 具体地说,如图6所显示的,对于图5所介绍的来自真实世界CBCT和ICASSP CBCT数据集的代表性片段,我们从两个同质区域手动进一步挑选出黄色和蓝色的ROI。 对每一数据集,对最不发达国家的图像和所有相竞方法的输出都采用了尺寸和空间位置相同的ROI。 ROI是在同质区域内选择的,远离明显的组织界限,以减少解剖变异对CNR和Std计算的影响. 黄色和蓝色的ROI被用于计算CNR,而黄色ROI则被额外用于计算Std. 由于CNR和Std对ROI选择很敏感,所报数值仅从图6所示的代表性切片中计算出,意在作为质量比较的补充量化度量,而不是作为数据集级性能度量. 噪声2Void和邻居2Neigbor2Neighbor在数量上只取得了略好于最初LDCT图像的成绩,而相邻的基于slice的自控基线,包括MM-Net,Noise2Sim,和SVB,一般都取得了更好的性能. 虽然SDCNN获得了有利的CNR和Std值,但它在ICASSP CBCT数据集上的总体定量性能仍然低于较强的相邻的切片基线,特别是噪声2Sim和SVB,这可能与其过沉的趋势有关。 为了进一步调查这一问题,我们进行了图6(a1)所示沿绿线段跨越空中边界的分线分析,图7所示。 如红色箭头所显示,与SDCNN相对应的绿色曲线表现出了更渐进的跨越空中边界的强度过渡,为过度出气提供了进一步的证据. 相形之下,与噪声2Match对应的红色曲线保持了相对陡峭的强度过渡,其过渡趋势与原LDCT图像相类似. 这表明"噪声2Match"可以在保持空中边界的同时有效抑制噪声,而不会明显地过沉. 总体而言,噪声2Match在CBCT数据集上都取得了最佳的定量性能,并显示出明显优于相竞争的自控方法. 这些定量和定性的结果表明,噪声2Match能够以自我监督的方式有效进行低剂量CBCT去诺,同时保持有利的组织对比,噪声抑制和结构保存.

blocks.en: III-F Analysis of Inter-Slice Noise Correlation
blocks.zh: III-F 不同会场间噪音关联分析

blocks.en: In this section, we quantitatively analyze the inter-slice noise correlation before and after the correction operation. This analysis was conducted on the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, Real-World CBCT, and ICASSP CBCT datasets. Utilizing the well-trained f θ f_{\theta} and M ϕ M_{\phi} , we estimated the label transition matrices T ^ i , k + = M ϕ ​ ( f θ ​ ( x i ) , f θ ​ ( x i + k ) ) \hat{T}_{i,k^{+}}=M_{\phi}(f_{\theta}(x_{i}),f_{\theta}(x_{i+k})) . As illustrated in Fig. 8 , for every dataset and inter-slice distance k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } k\in\{1,2,3,4,5\} , 100 slice pairs ( x i , x i + k ) (x_{i},x_{i+k}) , each with five ROIs from different locations, were randomly selected from the training set for the calculation of the inter-slice noise correlation before and after correction. For the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, and ICASSP CBCT datasets, the noise map n i n_{i} of the noisy slice x i x_{i} was obtained as n i = x i − s i n_{i}=x_{i}-s_{i} , where s i s_{i} denotes the corresponding clean reference image. blocks.en: We conducted ablation experiments on the Mayo 2016 Dataset to evaluate the effects of the proposed inter-slice matching network M ϕ M_{\phi} , the correction loss ℒ C ​ o ​ r ​ r \mathcal{L}_{Corr} , the smooth loss ℒ S ​ m \mathcal{L}_{Sm} , and the loss reweighting mechanism ( R . When all proposed components were removed, the denoiser was trained directly using the loss function in Eq. ( 2 ). As shown in Fig. 10 (c), residual noise remained in the denoised images, and the quantitative metrics dropped by 2.22 dB in PSNR, 0.0181 in SSIM, and increased by 4.94 HU in RMSE compared to the full Noise2Match listed in the fourth row of Table V . This indicates that directly training the model with adjacent slices leads to considerable interference in denoising performance due to mean differences caused by anatomical variation. When only M ϕ M_{\phi} and ℒ C ​ o ​ r ​ r \mathcal{L}_{Corr} were incorporated, without ℒ S ​ m \mathcal{L}_{Sm} and loss reweighting, the model performed even worse. Fig. 10 (d) shows noticeable granular noise, and the quantitative metrics in the second row of Table V were the lowest. We speculate that the absence of smoothness constraints allowed M ϕ M_{\phi} to output deformation fields with excessive distortions or folds that did not conform to the natural anatomical variations, thereby interfering with the optimization of the denoiser. Incorporating M ϕ M_{\phi} , ℒ C ​ o ​ r ​ r \mathcal{L}_{Corr} , and ℒ S ​ m \mathcal{L}_{Sm} together, with loss reweighting disabled (corresponding to t ​ h → ∞ th\rightarrow\infty ), improved the denoising performance. Nevertheless, some fine structural details in the ROIs of Fig. 10 (e) remained slightly blurred compared to Fig. 10 (f). Finally, incorporating all the proposed components enabled the denoising model to achieve the highest-quality image results and optimal quantitative scores. These experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the inter-slice matching network M ϕ M_{\phi} , correction loss ℒ C ​ o ​ r ​ r \mathcal{L}_{Corr} , smooth loss ℒ S ​ m \mathcal{L}_{Sm} , and loss reweighting mechanism in our proposed Noise2Match.

blocks.en: We investigated the effect of the inter-slice distance parameter k k on the performance of Noise2Match. Fig. 11 shows representative image results obtained with different k k values on the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, Real-World CBCT, and ICASSP CBCT datasets. Table VI lists the quantitative results on the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, and ICASSP CBCT datasets. As shown in Fig. 11 , when k = 1 k=1 , Noise2Match achieves favorable image results on the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, and ICASSP CBCT datasets, effectively suppressing noise while preserving fine anatomical structures. However, on the Real-World CBCT dataset, noticeable residual noise can still be observed when k = 1 k=1 . This may be because the noise correlation between adjacent slices in this dataset remains relatively strong at k = 1 k=1 . The red curves in Fig. 8 also support this observation: when k = 1 k=1 , the inter-slice noise correlation before correction in the Real-World CBCT dataset is clearly higher than that in the other three datasets. When k = 2 k=2 , Noise2Match achieves the best visual performance on the Real-World CBCT dataset, with substantially reduced residual noise and well-preserved structural information. However, for the other three datasets, further increasing k k does not bring additional benefits, but instead leads to a certain degree of image smoothing. As k k further increases to 3 and 4, although noise can still be effectively suppressed, the image results on all datasets exhibit more pronounced over-smoothing, with many fine structural details being lost. The quantitative results in Table VI are generally consistent with the visual observations in Fig. 11 . When k = 1 k=1 , the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, and ICASSP CBCT datasets all achieve the best quantitative scores. As k k increases, PSNR and SSIM gradually decrease on all three datasets, while RMSE gradually increases. These qualitative and quantitative results indicate that although a larger k k can help reduce inter-slice noise correlation, it also increases the structural differences between adjacent slices, making it more difficult for the inter-slice matching network to accurately match pixels belonging to the same tissues, thereby compromising the preservation of fine structural details.

blocks.en: The above analysis shows that the selection of k k essentially involves a trade-off between inter-slice noise correlation and inter-slice structural differences. A larger k k generally reduces inter-slice noise correlation, making the constructed slice pairs better aligned with the noise-independence assumption. However, it may also introduce more pronounced anatomical differences between slices, making inter-slice matching more challenging. In practical applications, k k can be determined using the following two strategies. The first strategy is to measure the inter-slice noise correlation in homogeneous regions of the original images before model training, so that values of k k associated with excessively high inter-slice noise correlation can be excluded. This measurement does not require clean reference images. Specifically, the low-frequency anatomical components within homogeneous regions can first be approximated using Gaussian smoothing or a similar method and then subtracted from the original noisy images to obtain approximate noise maps, based on which the inter-slice noise correlation can be estimated. The second strategy is to adjust k k according to the visual quality of the model outputs on the training data. Specifically, if noticeable residual noise remains in the output images, it usually indicates that k k is too small and that the inter-slice noise correlation remains relatively high. In contrast, if obvious over-smoothing appears in the output images, it usually indicates that k k is too large and that the increased inter-slice structural differences between slices have adversely affected model training. Following these strategies, we set k = 1 k=1 for the Mayo 2016, Mayo 2020, Piglet, and ICASSP CBCT datasets, and k = 2 k=2 for the Real-World CBCT dataset.
blocks.zh: 以上分析显示,kk的选取基本上涉及切片间噪声关联和切片间结构差异之间的取舍. 一个更大的k k一般会降低相片间相片噪声的相关性,使所构造的切片对能更好地与噪声-独立假设相匹配. 然而,它也可能引入切片间更明显的解剖差异,使切片间匹配更具挑战性. 在实际应用中,k k可以使用以下两种策略来确定. 第一个策略是在模型训练前测量原始图像在同位素区域的切片间噪声相通性,从而可以排除与切片间噪声相通性过高相通的k k值. 这种测量不需要干净的参考图像. 具体来说,同质区域内的低频解剖元件可以先用高斯平滑法或类似的方法来进行相近,再从原始的噪音图像中减去以得到相相近的噪音图,在此基础上可以估计相片间噪音的关联. 第二种战略是根据培训数据模型产出的可视质量调整kk. 具体地说,如果输出图像中还保留出明显的残留噪声,通常表示k k太小了,而相片间噪声的关联性仍然相对较高. 相形之下,如果输出图像中出现明显的过沉,则通常表明k k 太大了,切片之间增加的切片间结构差异对模型训练产生了不利影响. 按照这些策略,我们为2016年的"五月",2020年的"五月","小猪"和ICASSP CBCT数据集设定了k=1克=1;为"真"-"世界CBCT"数据集设定了k=2克=2.

blocks.en: IV Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Through theoretical analysis and experimental validation, we demonstrated that Noise2Match achieves superior denoising performance compared with existing state-of-the-art self-supervised methods, particularly for low-dose CBCT denoising. The reasons for Noise2Match’s outstanding performance can be summarized as follows. First , in addition to using adjacent LDCT slices with high similarity and better noise independence as training data, Noise2Match employs a correction operation that allows the transfer of supervision signals between adjacent slices to adapt to non-rigid misalignments caused by anatomical variation. Consequently, compared with existing adjacent-slice-based self-supervised methods, Noise2Match has better satisfaction for the equal-mean condition required by the Noise2Noise framework. Second , the correction operation in Noise2Match can match pixels that were originally at different positions in adjacent slices and had weaker noise correlation, further enhancing noise independence between slices. This enables Noise2Match to perform better low-dose CBCT denoising solely in the image domain, while existing self-supervised methods cannot accomplish this task well. Third , Noise2Match incorporates a loss reweighting strategy, which mitigates the interference from mismatched pixels at longitudinal tissue boundaries between adjacent slices, further improving model performance.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出"噪声2Match"(Noise2Match),这是一种基于适应性切片间匹配的自控LDCT去诺克方法. 通过理论分析和实验验证,我们证明"噪声2Match"比起现有的最先进的自控方法,特别是低剂量CBCT去诺能,实现了优异的去诺能性能. 噪声2Match出色表现的原因可归纳如下. 首先,除了使用相邻的LDCT切片具有高度相似性和更好的噪声独立性作为培训数据外,Noise2Match还采用了一种修正操作,允许相邻切片之间传递监督信号来适应解剖变异造成的非刚性错配. 因此,与现有的相邻切片自控方法相比,噪声2Match对噪声2Noise框架所要求的等同性条件有更好的满足. 第二,Noise2Match中的校正操作可以匹配原本位于相邻切片中不同位置并具有较弱噪声关联的像素,进一步提高了切片之间的噪声独立性. 这使得噪声2Match能够仅以图像域来进行更好的低剂量CBCT去诺能,而现有的自控方法无法很好地完成这项任务. 第三,"噪声2Match"包含了一个损失再加权策略,可以减轻相邻切片间纵向组织边界上不匹配像素造成的干扰,进一步改善了模型性能.

blocks.en: It should be noted that the equivalence established in Theorem 1 relies on several idealized assumptions. In practical implementations, these assumptions can generally be satisfied only approximately because spatial transformations of discrete images involve interpolation and the transition matrix estimated by M ϕ M_{\phi} may contain errors. Therefore, in practice, the Noise2Match training objective should be understood as approximately, rather than strictly, equivalent to the supervised denoising objective. Although some theoretical assumptions can only be approximately satisfied in practice, the empirical evaluation in Section III-H4 and the experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that these approximations do not prevent Noise2Match from achieving effective and robust denoising performance.
blocks.zh: 需要指出的是,在定理1中确立的等同性依赖于几个理想化的假设. 在实际执行中,这些假设一般只能大致满足,因为离散图像的空间变换涉及内插,而由M-Q-M-Phi}估计的过渡矩阵可能包含出错. 因此,在实践中,Noise2Match培训目标应被理解为大致而非严格意义上相当于受监督的去名目标。 虽然一些理论假设实际上只能大致满足,但第三节-H4中的经验评价以及跨多数据集的实验结果表明,这些近似并不妨碍Noise2Match实现有效而有力的去诺能性能.

blocks.en: In conclusion, in this work, we proposed Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. This method introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices and applies correction to the denoiser’s outputs, enabling the adjacent slices to better satisfy the independent and equal-mean conditions. Additionally, a loss reweighting mechanism is employed to further enhance the model’s performance. Both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that Noise2Match achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art image-domain self-supervised methods in various LDCT denoising tasks, particularly in low-dose CBCT denoising. Therefore, Noise2Match offers broader applicability and higher practical value.
blocks.zh: 最后,在这项工作中,我们提出了Noise2Match,这是一种基于适应性切片间匹配的自导自演的LDCT去名法. 这种方法引入了切片间匹配网络,以模拟相邻切片之间的标签过渡过程,并对切片的输出进行校正,使相邻切片能更好地满足独立和等同的条件. 此外,还采用了损失再加权机制来进一步提高模型的性能。 理论分析和多数据集的广泛实验都表明,Noise2Match在各种LDCT去诺能任务中,特别是在低剂量CBCT去诺能任务中,比最先进的图像领域自我监督的方法取得了优异的性能. 因此,噪声2Match提供了更广泛的适用性和更高的实用价值.
